csv_project_name: Consultant for Minnesota Local Road Safety Plan
csv_scope_of_work: MnDOT requests proposals from qualified consulting firms with experience in traffic safety, roadway data analysis, and transportation planning to improve the current CRSP or LRSP development process. The goal is to work with county and city transportation agencies to create a framework that is efficient, cost effective, and scalable. The work will support the use of proven safety countermeasures and align with national guidance. This effort advances Minnesota s Toward Zero Deaths initiative by improving how local agencies develop and implement safety plans that reduce fatal and serious injury crashes.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning
